title: Pomodoro Technique
summary: Work in focused 25 minute blocks separated by short breaks.

Set a timer for 25 minutes of single-task work, then take a five minute break. After four pomodoros take a longer break of twenty minutes. Useful against procrastination; see [[Gestão de Tempo Semanal]].
